other_failure_modes.description: When generating test set predictions inside a cross-validation loop, the fold predictions must be ensembled (e.g., averaged for probabilities or majority voted for classes). summary: The agent correctly establishes a 5-fold cross-validation scheme but fails to perform any data cleaning or feature engineering. Critically, it introduces a severe bug by concatenating rather than ensembling the test predictions from each fold, resulting in a submission file that is 5 times longer than the actual test set.
